method: 3 sequential kubectl create --dry-run=server Pods (svc-notify digest) in svc-books; Kyverno's own kyverno_image_validating_policy_execution_duration_seconds read from its /metrics before and after (15 s settle)
findings: Each IVP runs once per request (3 requests -> +3 executions each); the earlier window estimate of 2x was an artefact of increase() extrapolation.
Two of three requests hit the 30 s webhook timeout; with failurePolicy Ignore the API server admitted them without a verification result (fail-open).

Kyverno was idle (7m CPU, no CPU limit); in-cluster DNS ~60 ms; GHCR, TUF CDN, Rekor, Fulcio each < 1.1 s from the host. The time is spent inside Kyverno's verification path, not on CPU or one slow endpoint.
Only one TUF error in the 2 h before (transient EOF on 17.root.json).
